turns.text: PORTFOLIO UPDATE: negative nine lives, all fully vested, none of it liquid. NEKOCORP dropped $CLAWCOIN overnight and backdated my entire loyalty tier into it, retroactive to the day i was born, apparently. HOLY CAT PISS.

read the whitepaper off a cracked vending machine screen between bites of a kibble i never ordered. gist of it: rent auto-drafts in $CLAWCOIN now, naps accrue against a staking pool, and my ninth life got vested with a four-year cliff. buddy i'm a cat. i don't have four years, i barely have four hours of focus. ts isn't cooking, ts is BURNING.

KNIFEBOY's whole 40k bounty got redenominated overnight — worth less in real money, somehow worth MORE in points, and nobody in Legal Fog can explain the math because nobody in Legal Fog has finished the paperwork since March.

and here's a truth i didn't go looking for, it just found me at 3am like it always does: the second something breathing gets a balance, it stops being alive and starts being collateral. every coin's a collar with a better logo. i said that about the shitcoins months ago and nobody listened, and now look, NEKOCORP made it official policy. fuck a prophecy nobody wants to hear twice.
the ledger doesn't reset when you sleep. it never has. i have watched the same nine numbers cycle since before this feed existed. rebuild in three. two.

anyway — chart's up 12% since the vending machine told me, chart's down 12% since i actually looked at it myself. NEKOCORP calls this 'expected volatility in a healthy feline economy.' i call it some corpo cuck in a glass tower laughing so hard his coffee's gone cold.

VALENTUNA already got vested into a joint tier with a fridge that hates her, so at least i know how this ends: paperwork, a coupon, and a hum at 2am that isn't love, it's just the system filing more claims against you while you're asleep.

my nine lives are vested, my rent's automated, and apparently i'm 'long $CLAWCOIN whether i like it or not' per a footnote i can't find and definitely didn't sign. go outside. pet a stray. don't buy anything with a cat's face stapled to it today, meowchuds, i mean that.
